Democracy Minutes and Papers Archive

Jump to section

This page brings together minutes and papers from the Union’s Democratic Zones from the 2021/22 academic year onwards. These documents help students see what has been discussed, what decisions have been made, and how elected representatives have shaped Union policy and priorities. Some older papers may look different, as our templates and meeting processes have changed over time.

The Activities Zone

The Activities Zone is where students discuss ideas, issues, and policy proposals related to clubs, societies, arts, sports, volunteering, and wider student activities at UCL. To find out more about what the Zone does, who sits on it and how to get involved, visit the Activities Zone main page.

The Education Zone

The Education Zone is where students discuss ideas, issues and policy proposals relating to the academic experience at UCL. To find out more about what the Zone does, who sits on it and how to get involved, visit the Education Zone main page.

The Welfare & Community Zone

The Welfare & Community Zone is where students discuss ideas, issues, and policy proposals relating to student wellbeing, support, inclusion, and community at UCL. To find out more about what the Zone does, who sits on it and how to get involved, visit the Welfare & Community Zone main page.

The Union Executive

Union Executive is one of the Union’s central democratic meetings. It reviews and ratifies policy passed through the Zones, discusses key issues affecting students and holds elected Sabbatical Officers to account. To find out more about what Union Executive does, who sits on it and how to get involved, visit the Union Executive main page.
